sections.section_title: RDP protection and life cycle management
sections.text_helper: Section 6.5.7 "RDP protection and life cycle management" in chapter 6 (Embedded flash memory (FLASH)), RM0522 Rev 1, page 159.
sections.section_content:
Nonvolatile states, or debug states, are determined by the RDP levels set by user option
bytes. Debug possibility and possibility to change selected security settings are related to
this state. While the state is stored in the OB, it is the SBS that controls the debug policy.
